A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete, readable 14-page paper, including Appendices A-C. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical paper content apart from the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendices A and C report original watermark-detection experiments, tests on public model deployments, and watermark-parameter estimation results.

after.justification: Retains the same original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendices A and C, including Tables 1-4 and Figures 2-3.

M1.justification: The three watermark-detection procedures in Sections 2-4 and the parameter estimators in Appendix C are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same tasks and scenarios across five open-source models and GPT4, CLAUDE 3, and GEMINI 1.0 PRO deployments. Appendix coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 3 retain the same unwatermarked controls and seven watermark variants. No comparison method is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: Query budgets, temperatures, response lengths, sample sizes, watermark parameters, and testing procedures in Section 5 and the appendices are unchanged.

E4.justification: The sampling-error and diversity analyses in Section 5.2, multiple-key robustness experiment in Appendix A, and parameter-estimation analyses in Appendix C are identical.

E5.justification: Both retain reporting over 100 experiment repetitions and, additionally for Red-Green schemes, five watermark keys. Permutation tests, confidence intervals, and bootstrapping practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1-4, plotted results in Figures 2-3, and textual findings are identical, including the absence of significant watermark evidence for the tested public deployments.

T1.justification: Mathematical assumptions, definitions, and derivations are identical, including Equations (1)-(12) and the appendix parameter-estimation reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about practical black-box watermark detection, the effectiveness of the proposed tests, and findings for public deployments.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including Section 7's restrictions concerning watermark families and modeling assumptions, and Appendix C's qualifications about parameter estimation.

D1.justification: Prompt templates, implementation and experimental parameters, query-cost information, and Appendix B's scheme details are identical. Resource-access information and link destinations are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 6, the in-text citations, and all 23 references are identical. Positioning relative to earlier watermark attacks and detection methods is unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page marginal stamp changes from arXiv:2405.20777v1 dated 28 May 2024 to v2 dated 13 Jul 2024. Prose, headings, authors, and document structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1-3, Tables 1-4, captions, and page layout are identical. Rendered differences are confined to the version/date stamp, with no layout revision.

improvement.justification: Only the arXiv version/date stamp changes. Scientific content, empirical evidence, exposition, limitations, and reproducibility information remain identical throughout the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful difference in overall quality.
